what: Two layers of the hero photo collage follow the mouse in opposite directions. The target is the distance from screen center to cursor × .005, and each frame closes .1 of the remaining gap (settles in about .6s). The front layer (cut-out person) and back layer (scattered photos) cross over, giving depth

options.sens: Multiplier for distance (per thousand), default 5 — about ±3.6px at the screen edge (1440 width)
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Layers to move (one or more). data-dir="1" If so, the cursor side, "-1" If set, reverse — if not, alternate first layer 1 and second layer −1

use:
Cut-out figures
Scattered photos
note: Not applied on touch devices or with reduced motion (stays in place)
